name: Hermitage Bay
positioning: Secluded villa resort on its own bay on Antigua's west coast, with villas set between the hillside and the shore
best_for: Travelers who want a private villa with its own pool or hot tub
Guests looking to unplug on a quiet, private bay
Small groups who want a three-bedroom villa together

facts.text: Hermitage Bay sits on Antigua's west coast, and its namesake bay is shared with no one else.
Hermitage Bay opened to visitors around the winter holidays in 2006.
Each villa has air conditioning, an outdoor shower and a generous stand-alone tub.
Rattan accents, white linens and mosquito-netted beds give the rooms a Balinese-esque look, with hideaway TVs.
The open-air spa is wrapped in lush gardens, with the sea before it.
Every spa treatment is performed with ESPA.
There is a Technogym fitness center, with personal training available on request.
Guests can choose an all-inclusive plan or bed and breakfast.
The resort grows many of its own seasonal fruits, vegetables and herbs in an on-site organic garden.
The circular Tree Bar is tucked beneath the branches at the edge of the beach.
Many of the staff have been at the resort for more than a decade.
Snorkeling, paddleboarding and kayaking gear are available.

highlights.text: The villas are scattered between the hillside and the shore, and every one has a private pool or hot tub.
The Hillside Ocean Pool Villas sit high on the hillside with views over Hermitage Bay and an unobstructed sunset each night.
The Sanctuary is a private three-bedroom villa with a sun terrace, sauna, cold plunge and jacuzzi pavilion.
Yoga, meditation and Pilates take place daily above the sea.
Two speed boats and a 103-foot sailboat are on property for boating trips, deep sea fishing and sunset cruises.

considerations.text: The resort is on the western side of the island, with nothing within walking distance.
Because the property is very much on the beach, some spaces may be hard to navigate for guests with mobility issues.
Large electronics are largely discouraged around the property.
